summary: Marco arrives at Barajas Airport with signed contract. Meets Elena. Arrives at her apartment. Lies to his mother about the job.

states.c1: Arrived in Madrid, hopeful, hiding growing anxiety about first day
states.c2: Welcomes Marco, skeptical but supportive, offers shelter

summary: Marco discovers the architecture firm has closed. The job does not exist. He learns he will need to find work illegally or leave Madrid.

states.c1: Devastated, realizes his plan is destroyed, still has not told family
states.c2: Offers practical support without judgment, leaves job listing

summary: Marco decides to lie to his mother about having the job. Takes first construction work. Meets Javier. Proves himself capable. Moves to basement room with Javier.

states.c1: Commits to the lie, begins construction work, discovers he has architectural knowledge to supervise, slightly more confident
states.c3: Believes Marco's lie about successful job
states.c4: First contact, impressed by Marco's competence, offers friendship and housing

summary: Marco settles into construction work with Javier. Learns about undeclared labor networks. Moves to basement room with Javier and Fatima (landlord). Deeper into the lie with his mother.

states.c1: Physical exhaustion, hands destroyed by work, adapting to illegal labor life, maintaining lie remotely
states.c4: Continues mentoring Marco, shows him survival philosophy of living day-to-day
states.c3: Continues believing the lie, Marco rarely contacts her

summary: Marco attempts to navigate immigration system. Meets Miguel Ferrero, learns there is no legal path for him to stay. Receives deportation notice. Realizes the system has rejected him. Accepts his illegal status as permanent.

states.c1: Destroyed by bureaucratic rejection, accepts permanence of illegal status, gives up on legal solutions
states.c5: Indifferent bureaucrat enforcing system, neither cruel nor kind, just procedural
states.c3: Still believes the lie, Marco less frequently available

summary: Marco stops thinking of staying as temporary. His reputation grows in construction. Elena contacts him, they reconnect. Elena's mother Fatima introduces Marco to network of displaced people. Marco accepts project-lead role.

states.c1: Stops planning departure, becomes integrated in undeclared worker networks, begins imagining permanent future
states.c2: Re-engages with Marco, brings him back into her life, witness to his transformation
states.c4: Continues as closest friend and mentor
states.fatima: Recognizes Marco's displacement, integrates him into displaced network, becomes mentor figure

summary: Marco's mother arrives unexpectedly in Madrid. Sees the basement room and understands the truth immediately. Marco confesses everything: the closed firm, illegal work, the lie. Mother accepts him without judgment. Walks through Madrid together.

states.c1: Confession and reckoning, shame dissolves into acceptance, becomes visible to mother
states.c3: Initially shocked and disappointed, but accepts Marco as a person independent of career, extends unconditional love

summary: Marco's mother spends a week in Madrid, meets his community (Elena, Javier, Fatima, displaced network). Marco calls family to tell the truth. Returns to construction work and displaced community. Accepts identity as invisible but real person. Builds a community kitchen with displaced nurse.

states.c1: Fully accepts reality, no longer performing for distant family, integrated into community, begins rebuilding with honest foundation
states.c3: Returns to Peru knowing the truth, has expressed acceptance through father
states.c4: Continues close friendship, part of Marco's established community
states.fatima: Mentor in displaced networks, confirms Marco's belonging
